title: Argentinian Beef Bowl
description: Tender beef, smoky flavors and nourishing goodness in every bite. Perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: Season the flank steak with salt and pepper.
Grill the steak for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoky chipotle peppers and Argentinian chimichurri.
Slice the red onion and add it to the bowl with the peppers and chimichurri.
Stir in the fresh cilantro and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sliced steak on top of the smoky onion mixture in a bowl.
